t: This is the statue of Charles II near the centre of Soho Square. It shows the king standing on a low decorated pedestal. The Danish sculptor Caius Gabriel Cibber made it, and it was once part of a seventeenth-century fountain. In the late nineteenth century it was moved to a private estate in Harrow, and it came back to the square in the mid-twentieth century. It is heavily eroded now and in poor condition, though it has been restored in the past.
